WITH LATESTMEMBERDATA AS (     SELECT [MedicaidID], [MemberLastName], [MemberFirstName], [ProviderName_1], [ProviderType_1],[ProviderStartDate_1],[ProviderEndDate_1], [ProviderName_2], [ProviderType_2], [ProviderStartDate_2],[ProviderEndDate_2],         [ProviderName_3], [ProviderType_3],[ProviderStartDate_3],[ProviderEndDate_3], [ProviderName_4], [ProviderType_4],[ProviderStartDate_4],[ProviderEndDate_4], [ProviderName_5], [ProviderType_5],   		 [ProviderStartDate_5],[ProviderEndDate_5], [TapeDate]     FROM [Enroll].[DBO].[Iowa_Provider]     WHERE          (             ProviderName_1 LIKE 'DELTA DENTAL%' OR ProviderName_2 LIKE 'DELTA DENTAL%' OR ProviderName_3 LIKE 'DELTA DENTAL%' OR              ProviderName_4 LIKE 'DELTA DENTAL%' OR ProviderName_5 LIKE 'DELTA DENTAL%'         )         AND          (             ProviderType_1 = 'DEN' OR ProviderType_2 = 'DEN' OR ProviderType_3 = 'DEN' OR              ProviderType_4 = 'DEN' OR ProviderType_5 = 'DEN'         )         AND          (             TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderStartDate_1]) <= GETDATE() OR TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderStartDate_2]) <= GETDATE() OR              TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderStartDate_3]) <= GETDATE() OR TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderStartDate_4]) <= GETDATE() OR              TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderStartDate_5]) <= GETDATE()         )         AND          (             TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderEndDate_1]) >= GETDATE() OR TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderEndDate_2]) >= GETDATE() OR              TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderEndDate_3]) >= GETDATE() OR TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderEndDate_4]) >= GETDATE() OR              TRY_CONVERT(DATE, [ProviderEndDate_5]) >= GETDATE()         ) ) SELECT * FROM LATESTMEMBERDATA WHERE TapeDate = (SELECT MAX(TapeDate) FROM LATESTMEMBERDATA);
